description:
Write to tv@sumtv.org, and get your Bible questions answered on a future program!
The following questions are answered in this Q & A program:
. 
These questions were answered simultaneously.
(3:52) Please explain about the other worlds EGW mentioned.
1. Where are they?
2. How many worlds could be there?
3 Are they watching us?
4. If they are unfallen, then there is no death. If there is no death, won't the world be overpopulated?
5. When they were created, before or after Adam?
6. Do they look like humans?
7. If they looked like humans, obviously Adam was not the first human to be created.
8. When it's written "all eyes are going to see Jesus return", are the other worlds going to watch as well?
.
.
